egis.note: Official SQUID MANIA shop (squid-mania.com, linked from the brand site squid-mania.jp; the brand site itself has no B-TR spec page). Category 'Boat/Tip-Run'. Size pages: 2.5号15g https://www.squid-mania.com/product-list/1635 , 3.0号25g https://www.squid-mania.com/product-list/1634 , 3.5号30g https://www.squid-mania.com/product-list/1591 . Items are titled e.g. '3.5号 30ｇB-TR (BT27)夢幻 Fire RED(UV)[オレンジ/金/銀]'; colours here = code + name, the bracketed part after the name is the 下地/base description and is omitted. All 27 colours (BT01-BT27) are listed in all three sizes, no gaps. One weight per size. Price 1,540円 (税込). Stock varies per item (several show [×] = out of stock on 2026-11-12).
